description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Jerusalem sits alone like a widow, abandoned by her lovers and with no one to comfort her. She confesses her sin and calls on those who pass by to see her suffering.
1.sw: Yerusalemu inakaa peke yake kama mjane, imeachwa na wapenzi wake na haina mtu wa kuifariji. Inaungama dhambi yake na kuwaita wapita njia waone mateso yake.
1.am: ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ መበለት ብቻዋን ተቀምጣለች፤ ወዳጆቿ ትተዋታል፤ የሚያጽናናትም የላትም። ኃጢአቷን ትናዘዛለች፤ መንገደኞችም መከራዋን እንዲያዩ ትጣራለች።

2.en: In anger God has thrown down the strongholds of Zion and destroyed the temple. Children faint in the streets, and the city is called to pour out its heart to God.
2.sw: Kwa hasira Mungu amezibomoa ngome za Sayuni na kuliharibu hekalu. Watoto wanazimia barabarani, na mji unaitwa kumimina moyo wake kwa Mungu.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው የጽዮንን ምሽጎች አፍርሷል፤ ቤተ መቅደሱንም አጥፍቷል። ሕፃናት በአደባባይ ይዝላሉ፤ ከተማዪቱም ልቧን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንድታፈስስ ትጠራለች።

3.en: A man who has seen affliction tells how God has walled him in and broken him, yet he recalls that God's loyal love never ends and God's mercies are new each morning. He calls the people to return to God.
3.sw: Mtu aliyeona mateso anaeleza jinsi Mungu alivyomzungushia ukuta na kumvunja, lakini anakumbuka kwamba upendo usiokoma wa Mungu haukomi na huruma za Mungu ni mpya kila asubuhi. Anawaita watu wamrudie Mungu.
3.am: መከራን ያየ ሰው እግዚአብሔር እንዴት በቅጥር እንደ ከበበውና እንደ ሰበረው ይናገራል፤ ሆኖም የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ፍቅር እንደማያልቅና ርኅራኄው በየማለዳው አዲስ እንደ ሆነ ያስታውሳል። ሕዝቡም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲመለሱ ይጣራል።

4.en: The gold has lost its shine, the people starve, and the princes are unrecognizable. Jerusalem's punishment is complete, and Edom will be punished in turn.
4.sw: Dhahabu imepoteza mng'ao wake, watu wana njaa kali, na wakuu hawatambuliki. Adhabu ya Yerusalemu imekamilika, na Edomu itaadhibiwa kwa zamu yake.
4.am: ወርቁ ድምቀቱን አጥቷል፤ ሕዝቡ ይራባሉ፤ መኳንንቱም የማይታወቁ ሆነዋል። የኢየሩሳሌም ቅጣት ተፈጽሟል፤ ኤዶምም በተራዋ ትቀጣለች።

5.en: The people ask God to remember their disgrace, for their inheritance has gone to strangers. They pray that God will restore them, unless God has utterly rejected them.
5.sw: Watu wanamwomba Mungu aikumbuke aibu yao, kwa maana urithi wao umewaendea wageni. Wanaomba Mungu awarejeshe, isipokuwa amewakataa kabisa.
5.am: ሕዝቡ ርስታቸው ለእንግዶች ስለ ተላለፈ እግዚአብሔር ውርደታቸውን እንዲያስብ ይለምናሉ። ፈጽሞ ካልጣላቸው በቀር እግዚአብሔር እንዲመልሳቸው ይጸልያሉ።
